== Chapter summaries ==

I apologize for the delay in replying, I'm not getting on here very often at present.

You've probably already discovered the [[template:summary|chapter summary template]]. That's going to be the easiest way to get started on chapters; just fill out the basics at first and things can be added in later. Also if you don't have time to fill out the full thing, slapping a [[:Category:Chapter stubs|chapter stub template]] will be useful when people are looking for something to do later (Gherald disagrees with me on this, he prefers redlinks to stubs).

The 'standard' format for chapters is at [[Wotwiki:Chapter_summaries#Skeleton]], if you want to do a more complete job, can be filled it a bit at a time starting at the top. Blanks are not a big deal, especially in the "characters mentioned", etc sections near the bottom. Hope that helps! -- ''[[User:Nae'blis|nae]]'[[User_talk:Nae'blis|blis]]'' 19:20, 23 April 2009 (UTC)
